description: SphereX is a one-person student team from Antalya, Türkiye, working on the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge. I love astronomy: constellations, stars and discovering new things about our universe. For Space Apps 2026 I built SPHEREx: Sky Detective, a free web game in English and Turkish where players compare SPHEREx-style infrared sky maps over time to find comets, asteroids and a Planet X candidate. Interests: astronomy, games, coding and science education.
